title: hieracium froelichianum subsp. heterolobum
intro: Hieracium froelichianum subsp. heterolobum, commonly known as the hawkweed, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium froelichianum subsp. heterolobum include antimicrobial, antiviral, and antitumor activities, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
